fullDescription: Light split-screen SaaS hero for an AI product-design agent: white ground with a soft emerald wash and a faint dotted grid, Inter type. Left = a NEW eyebrow pill, a big two-line headline with one emerald accent word, a sub-line, a solid-emerald + white dual CTA and a 5-star social-proof row; right = a floating product-app window (top bar, tool rail, infinite canvas with a generated dashboard in an emerald selection box, Layers/Style panel, AI prompt bar) plus a floating notification chip, a phone mock and a trust logo strip.
prompt:
## Resumo
A clean, light split-screen SaaS hero for an AI product-design agent. White ground with a soft emerald wash and a faint dotted grid; Inter throughout. Left column carries a 'NEW' eyebrow pill, a big two-line headline with one emerald accent word, a sub-paragraph, a dual CTA (solid emerald primary + white 'watch demo' secondary) and an avatar + 5-star social-proof line. Right column shows a floating product mock: a rounded app window with a top bar, a left tool rail, an infinite-canvas center holding a generated fintech dashboard inside an emerald selection bounding-box, a right Layers/Style panel and a bottom AI prompt bar; plus a floating 'Design ready' notification chip and a small floating phone mock. A thin 'Trusted by teams at' logo strip closes the section.

## Estilo Visual
Design a light, modern SaaS product-marketing hero in a single-emerald-accent style. Palette: page background #ffffff, ink text #0b1220, slate2 #334155 (body), slate3 #64748b, slate4 #94a3b8 (tertiary), hairline border #e2e8f0; emerald ramp 50 #ecfdf5 / 100 #d1fae5 / 200 #a7f3d0 / 300 #6ee7b7 / 400 #34d399 / 500 #10b981 / 600 #059669 / 700 #047857 / 800 #065f46 / 900 #064e3b. Use exactly ONE accent (emerald): emerald-700 solid CTAs (hover emerald-800), emerald-600 for the single accent word in the headline, emerald-500 for the logo/icon badges, and emerald-50/100 for soft tinted fills and chips. Typography: Inter for all text (weights 400-900), display headline at clamp ~40->56px, line-height ~1.04, tracking -0.025em, with one word colored emerald-600; body at ~16.5-17.5px in slate2; tabular-nums on figures. Build the 'hero wash' background: layer radial-gradient(80% 90% at 88% 8%, rgba(16,185,129,.16), transparent 58%) + radial-gradient(70% 80% at 6% 14%, rgba(52,211,153,.10), transparent 55%) over linear-gradient(180deg,#f0fdf7,#f7fdfb 46%,#ffffff); add a faint 22px square grid (rgba(15,23,42,.045) 1px lines) radially masked into the upper-right (mask-image radial 70% 60% at 82% 8%). Shadows: card = 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.06), 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(15,23,42,.10); float = 0 24px 60px -22px rgba(15,23,42,.28), 0 4px 14px -6px rgba(15,23,42,.12); chip = 0 8px 22px -10px rgba(15,23,42,.22); btn glow = 0 10px 22px -10px rgba(16,185,129,.55). Sticky nav and small chips use backdrop-blur frosted glass. Rounded corners (lg 0.5rem / xl 0.75rem / 2xl 1rem); text selection emerald (#a7f3d0 on #064e3b). Icons: Lucide via the iconify-icon web component. Keep it light, calm, premium and trustworthy, single emerald accent only, never dark or neon.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header (z-50, full width) with a translucent white background (bg-white/80) + saturate/blur backdrop and a hairline bottom border (#e2e8f0). Inside a max-w-[1180px] row, height 64px: LEFT = brand (a rounded emerald-500 badge with btn glow holding a white Lucide pen-tool icon, next to an extrabold 'Drafted' wordmark) followed by primary nav links (Product with chevron-down, Prompt library, Pricing, Resources with chevron-down, Docs) in medium slate2 ~14.5px that get an emerald-50 hover background, hidden below lg. RIGHT = a square ghost search icon button (hidden below sm), a 'Log in' text link (hidden below md), a solid emerald-700 pill CTA 'Start free' with a Lucide arrow-right and btn glow (hover emerald-800), and a hamburger menu button shown only below lg.

### Hero left (copy)
A left copy column (lg:col-span-5, max-w-xl). Top: an eyebrow pill = a rounded-full white/70 glass chip with an emerald-200 border and chip shadow, containing a small solid emerald-500 'NEW' tag (white bold 11px) then emerald-700 text 'Canvas 2.0 — multi-screen flows'. Then an extrabold ink headline (~40->56px, leading 1.04, tracking -0.025em): 'Ship beautiful UI' / line break / 'from a single ' + the word 'prompt' colored emerald-600. Then a ~16.5-17.5px slate2 sub-paragraph: 'Drafted is the AI design agent that turns plain language into production-ready mockups, components, and full flows on an infinite canvas. Describe it, refine it, hand it to code.' Then a dual CTA row (stacks on mobile): a solid emerald-700 pill 'Start designing free' with arrow-right + btn glow, and a white bordered pill 'Watch 90-sec demo' with an emerald-600 play-circle icon and card shadow. Then a trust line: an overlapping cluster of three ring-2 ring-white avatars (emerald-200 'JZ', slate-200 'M', solid emerald-500 '+'), five emerald stars, and the text 'Loved by 57,000+ developers & designers. No credit card.' with the number bold ink + tabular-nums.

### Hero right (product mock)
A right column (lg:col-span-7) holding a centered max-w-[640px] floating app window: rounded-2xl white card with a large float shadow and a hairline ring. (1) App top bar: a small emerald-500 pen-tool badge + 'Fintech dashboard' title + an emerald-50 'Generating' pill with a sparkles icon on the left; three small status dots (two slate, one emerald-400) on the right. (2) App body = a 12-col grid on #fafcfb: a thin LEFT tool rail (col-span-1, hidden below sm) of vertically stacked Lucide tool icons (mouse-pointer-2 active ink, then square/type/image/layers in slate4); a CENTER canvas (col-span-8) with the faint dotted grid holding a 'generated screen' card (rounded-xl white, card shadow): a header row 'Total balance / $48,250.00' (extrabold tabular-nums) with an emerald-50 '+12.4%' trending-up pill, a 7-bar mini bar chart in ascending emerald tints (emerald-100..600) with Mon-Sun labels, and two divided activity rows ('Stripe payout +$2,400' in emerald with an arrow-down-left tile, 'Figma subscription -$45' with a credit-card tile); over the canvas an emerald-400/70 selection bounding-box with four white circular ring-emerald-500 corner handles. A RIGHT panel (col-span-3, hidden below sm): a 'LAYERS' label + 4 layer rows (Dashboard active in emerald-50, Balance card, Activity list, CTA button) and a 'STYLE' label + a swatch row (emerald-500 ringed, ink, slate-200, white). (3) Bottom prompt bar: a rounded input on #fafcfb with an emerald-500 sparkles icon, the placeholder 'Add a dark-mode variant and a savings-goal widget', and a solid emerald-500 send button with a white arrow-up icon and btn glow.

### Floating accents
Two floating elements overlapping the product window. TOP-RIGHT: a small white rounded-xl glass notification chip (float shadow, hairline ring) with an emerald-100 circle holding an emerald-600 check icon, then 'Design ready' (bold ink) over '3 screens generated' (tiny slate4). BOTTOM-LEFT (hidden below sm): a tiny phone mock = an ink (#0b1220) rounded-[20px] body with float shadow wrapping a white screen: an emerald-500 status strip with a white pill notch, a 'WALLET' label, an emerald-50 'Balance / $48.2k' card (extrabold tabular-nums), two slate placeholder bars, and a solid emerald-500 'Send money' button.

### Logo strip
A section-closing trust strip below the hero grid, inside max-w-[1180px]: a hairline top divider, then a centered wrapped row: an uppercase bold 'Trusted by teams at' label followed by five invented company marks in slate2, each a Lucide icon + name (command Northwind, hexagon Loophole, box Boxcar, triangle Vertex, aperture Lumen).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Hero 'wash' background: two emerald radial gradients (top-right + upper-left) over a white->mint->white vertical linear gradient, with a faint 22px dotted/line grid radially masked into the upper-right field

### Componente
Eyebrow glass pill: a rounded-full white/70 backdrop-blur chip with an emerald-200 border + chip shadow, holding a solid emerald-500 'NEW' tag and emerald-700 label text

### Componente
Dual CTA: a solid emerald-700 primary pill with an emerald-tinted glow shadow (hover emerald-800) paired with a white hairline-bordered secondary 'watch demo' pill carrying an emerald play-circle icon

### Componente
Social-proof cluster: overlapping ring-2 ring-white avatar circles (initials + a solid emerald '+'), five emerald Lucide stars, and a bold tabular-nums user count line

### Componente
Floating product-app window: rounded-2xl white card on a big soft 'float' shadow with a top bar, left tool rail, infinite-canvas center, right Layers/Style panel and a bottom AI prompt bar

### Componente
Generated-screen mock inside an emerald selection bounding-box: a fintech dashboard card (balance figure, +% pill, ascending emerald-tint bar chart, divided activity rows) wrapped by an emerald-400 ring with four white circular ring-emerald-500 corner handles

### Componente
Bottom AI prompt bar: a soft #fafcfb input with an emerald sparkles icon, an example prompt, and a solid emerald send button with a white arrow-up and btn glow

### Componente
Floating 'Design ready' glass notification chip (emerald check circle + two-line copy) and a small ink-bodied phone mock with an emerald wallet card and 'Send money' button

### Componente
Lucide (Iconify lucide:*) icons throughout: pen-tool, chevron-down, search, arrow-right, play-circle, star, sparkles, trending-up, arrow-down-left, credit-card, the canvas tool rail (mouse-pointer-2, square, type, image, layers), layout-dashboard, bar-chart-3, list, check, arrow-up, and the logo-strip marks (command, hexagon, box, triangle, aperture)

### Componente
Single-accent shadow system: card / float / chip / emerald btn-glow shadows plus frosted backdrop-blur on the sticky nav and small glass panels

## Notas Especiais
Font loaded from Google Fonts: Inter (400/500/600/700/800/900) used for everything. Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme: colors ink #0b1220, slate2 #334155, slate3 #64748b, slate4 #94a3b8, line #e2e8f0 and a full emerald ramp (50 #ecfdf5 / 100 #d1fae5 / 200 #a7f3d0 / 300 #6ee7b7 / 400 #34d399 / 500 #10b981 / 600 #059669 / 700 #047857 / 800 #065f46 / 900 #064e3b); custom boxShadow tokens card / float / chip / btn. Icons via the iconify-icon web component (lucide:* set). html has scroll-behavior:smooth and ::selection is emerald (#a7f3d0 on #064e3b). Keep a single emerald accent on a light white ground; layout is a sticky-nav + 12-col split hero (copy left, product mock right) closed by a logo strip, collapsing to one column below lg with the floating phone and side panels hidden on small screens. Never go dark, multi-color or neon.
